# archestra_agent_knowledge_source_exclusions (Resource)

Auto-mode knowledge-source exclusions for one agent: connectors omitted from its knowledge queries while `access_all_tools` is on (exclusions persist when it is off). **Authoritative over the agent's entire exclusion list** — every apply replaces the full set, and destroy clears it. Declare at most one per agent.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "archestra_agent_knowledge_source_exclusions" "example" {
  agent_id               = archestra_agent.example.id
  excluded_connector_ids = ["11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `agent_id` (String) Agent UUID. Pass the `id` from `archestra_agent`.
- `excluded_connector_ids` (Set of String) Knowledge connector UUIDs excluded from the agent's Auto-mode knowledge queries. An empty set is valid and clears all exclusions.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Same as `agent_id` — the exclusion list has no id of its own

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by the agent UUID.
terraform import archestra_agent_knowledge_source_exclusions.example 11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111
```
